test_title: PYST 05: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question:
Match the following.

 
 

 
 
A.

 
 
 
Propene

 
 
 
1.

 
 
 
Unsaturated 3 carbon chains with double bond

 
 
 

 
 
B.

 
 
 
Propyne

 
 
 
2.

 
 
 
Unsaturated 3 carbon chains with triple bond

 
 
 

 
 
C.

 
 
 
Propane

 
 
 
3.

 
 
 
Saturated 3 carbon bonds
solution:
The correct answer is __**2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Propene** (A) is an **unsaturated 3 carbon chain with a double bond**.
 
• **Propyne** (B) is an **unsaturated 3 carbon chain with a triple bond**.
 
• **Propane** (C) is a **saturated 3 carbon bond**.
 
• The correct matching is: **A - 1, B - 2, C - 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Propene** (C₃H₆) is also known as propylene.
 
• **Propyne** (C₃H₄) is also known as methylacetylene.
 
• **Propane** (C₃H₈) is commonly used as a fuel.
 
• Understanding the difference between saturated and unsaturated hydrocarbons is crucial in organic chemistry.
